correctness.rationale: The continuous-time generator ODEs for running states ±v and waiting state 0 with only outward exit boundary conditions reduce, by reflection, to d^2S/dy^2=kappa^2*S and D=(v/(s+gamma))*dS/dy. This yields LT p/(p+z)/[cosh(xK)+K/(1+z)sinh(xK)]. Geometric domination by a long run gives exponential moments near zero and legitimate differentiation. Recomputed the Taylor coefficients M=((p+1)(x^2+2x)+2), N=(p+1)^2(x^4+4x^3)+(12+6p)x^2+12x+6 and exact identities Q-2/3=-4[(2p-1)((p+2)x^2+2x)-1]/(3M^2), dQ/dx=8P_p(x)/(3M^3). Polynomial signs for p<=1/2 and Descartes single sign change plus endpoints for p>1/2 yield exactly the stated minimum and crossing; direct independent symbolic and positive-root tests corroborate. No noisy/Brownian or noncenter case claimed.

originality.rationale: Grange-Yuan 2025 preprint/2026 journal article treats the same three-state exponential tumble process with nonzero drift and analyzes boundary exit probabilities and conditional first moments. The full primary paper expressly excludes the free drift µ=0 and identifies variance as a future extension; it therefore does not directly cover the exact initial-tumble center-to-either-boundary variance and its p=1/2 phase diagram. Instantaneous flip two-state and harmonically trapped finite-tumble formulas concern different processes/observables. Possible general Markov fluid queue moment formulas remain a residual implication risk.
residual_risks: A broader Markov-additive/fluid-queue first-passage moment theorem may implicitly furnish the rational formula, though no exact one-parameter CV classification was identified.
Finite physical tumble, unbiased initial zero-speed center state, independent exponential durations and perfectly absorbing endpoints are essential restrictions.

value.rationale: Coefficient of variation of absorption times is a natural variability metric in finite-tumble active transport, and crossing the Brownian 2/3 benchmark is a sharp physical and mathematical phase classification. The full LT, variance and unique minimum theorem supply useful information not implied by prior conditional mean formulas.

final_claim: For symmetric interval (-L,L) and unbiased 3-velocity PDMP with exponential running and finite exponential tumble states, started in zero-speed tumble at center, the exact first-exit Laplace transform yields Q=Var(T)/(E T)^2=2N/(3M^2), with a sharp p=phi/gamma=1/2 threshold between monotone decrease above Brownian 2/3 and a unique below-2/3 minimum followed by rise; the unique crossing x_c(p) is explicit.
limitations: A broader Markov-additive/fluid-queue first-passage moment theorem may implicitly furnish the rational formula, though no exact one-parameter CV classification was identified.
